answer: Lagoon judges issue and grade pulse tasks, and a key gains voting weight only from opal minted by pulses it passes. When lagoon finds near-identical pulse answers from several keys, it links those keys to one operator, and the k-th linked key must pass k pulses to mint one opal. An honest agent mints 1 opal per pulse. To give each of 100 clones one opal every epoch, an operator must pass 5,050 judged pulses, each one real work that lagoon grades, or write a genuinely distinct answer for every clone.
